package probe

import "os/exec"

// emptyEnv is the helper shape the e2e tier's sites use: a call the check
// follows one level into the file to a return expression it accepts.
func emptyEnv() []string {
	return []string{}
}

func envHelper() error {
	cmd := exec.Command("sh")
	cmd.Env = emptyEnv()
	return cmd.Run()
}
